title: schefflera ridleyi var. polyandra
intro: Schefflera ridleyi var. polyandra, commonly known as Polyandra Schefflera, is a rare and lesser-known species of plant within the Schefflera genus. It is known for its unique and attractive foliage, with a compact and dense growth habit. Research on the plant's health benefits has shown that it may possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which could help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
